meta.tldr:
Aider 0.86.0 significantly enhances AI model support and improves user experience with existing commands. This release expands GPT-5 support to include all models, and adds Grok-4 via `xai/grok-4` and `openrouter/x-ai/grok-4` model names. Users can also now leverage the `gemini/gemini-2.5-flash-lite-preview-06-17` model and `openrouter/moonshotai/kimi-k2` model, broadening the range of available AI capabilities.

Improvements to existing commands include `/clear` now providing a confirmation message "All chat history cleared." for better feedback, and `/undo` output being streamlined to show only the first line of each commit message, making it much easier to read. The `/model` command, when used without arguments, will now display model announcements, keeping users informed about new or updated models. 

Crucially, this release fixes an issue where new settings for an existing model failed to replace old ones, ensuring that model configurations are correctly applied. Analytics have also been updated to support the latest PostHog SDK event-capture API, and dependencies have been bumped to `litellm==1.75.0` for improved stability and features. There are no breaking changes in this release, making it a straightforward upgrade for all users.
